content: Human-labeling session — expansion-balanced-2-base-defended:easy seed 1. Objective: Starter base in the NW (yard, barracks, power) and a spare MCV parked at the map centre. Drive the MCV east to (130,15) and deploy. Build at least one pillbox somewhere across your bases and train at least three rifles — a light patrol oscillates near the new candidate. Two yards (one at the eastern target), one pillbox, three units alive, within about 60 turns.
